about: Grand Theft Auto VI is the eighth main entry in the Grand Theft Auto series, following 2013's Grand Theft Auto V. The open world lets players freely roam Leonida and its Miami-inspired Vice City, with the story following the criminal duo of Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos as they try to escape corrupt police officers in a state-wide conspiracy.
summary: Grand Theft Auto VI is a 2026 action-adventure game developed and published by Rockstar Games. Set in the fictional US state of Leonida, based on Florida, the story follows Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos as they lead a life of crime to secure a better life and escape a state-wide criminal conspiracy.
